title: Output along a matching path
statement: Let $n$ be a nonnegative integer, let $\alpha$ be a type, and let $T$ be a decision tree with outputs in $\alpha$ whose queries are restricted to a set $I$ of the $n$ coordinates. If a path $P$ occurs among the paths of $T$ and an input $x\in\{0,1\}^n$ matches every coordinate value specified by $P$, then evaluating $T$ at $x$ gives the output recorded at the terminal leaf of $P$.
